adaptations: Send-only: submission on 2587 inside the container, published as public TCP 587; no port 25 listener and no IMAP.
Configuration is mounted read-only from the preset; credentials, DKIM keys and the queue live in /data.
TLS uses the certificate Hakopod issues for the service's generated hostname.
Runs as UID 10001 with a read-only root filesystem and every Linux capability dropped.
